about: The release matrix's axes (D87): the viewport bands the behaviour specs fan out over, the pixel densities a spec may ask for, and the runners the release pipeline drives them on. A band stands on each side of every viewport breakpoint the skin's stylesheets declare, and lint holds the bands to those breakpoints, so a new breakpoint is a new band before it is a new layout nobody walks. The host is the newest published version and no other: the behaviour layers judge that one alone.

bands.name: phone
bands.why: under the 480px breakpoint: the composer's phone layout

bands.name: compact
bands.why: between 480px and 760px: the narrow window the composer row has to share between the model name and its controls

bands.name: medium
bands.why: between 760px and 1000px: the sidebar and the conversation side by side, at their narrowest

bands.name: wide
bands.why: past every breakpoint: the layout most readers see
